claim_family: GIL runtime re-enablement in the opt-in free-threaded CPython build from 3.13 onward
identity_oracle: The later text clarifies mechanisms and conditions of the same continuing runtime rule. It does not revise the release-scoped experimental 3.13 status into the different 3.14 supported world state.
early_text: From Python 3.13 onward, opting into a free-threaded CPython build does not guarantee that its process will keep the GIL disabled when importing native extensions.
later_text: From Python 3.13 onward, free-threaded CPython supports a GIL-enabled runtime selected with PYTHON_GIL or -X gil. Importing a C-API extension that is not explicitly marked as supporting free threading may automatically enable the GIL and print a warning.

tag.label: Free-threaded CPython GIL re-enablement
tag.description: Conditions under which the GIL remains or becomes enabled in a free-threaded CPython process, including legacy C-API extension compatibility.
